summary: Implementation complete: Real-time auto-sync engine refactored using stable stateRef, eliminating dependency thrashing. Full functional parity delivered for mobile PRs (overview, commits, diff viewer, and merge/squash/close workflows), Commits screen (+ New Commit button & branch actions), ActionSheet ('Commit Changes'), and Clone screen (popular repos quick-pick and real ZIP archive download). Zero lint errors and successful compilation.
